profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software developer with a passion for science and education. Former science and mathematics teacher. Lifelong learner.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Coded applications for use in transportation infrastructure.  Built calculation algorithms and developed front-end.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Assistant Instructor – Full-Stack JavaScript Development (Code 401): Lead/managed TAs and lectured on Node.js, test-driven development and other MEAN stack topics in a 10-week course designed to prepare students for careers in web development. Worked with students to debug code and build Angular clients for REST frameworks. 

Lead Instructor - Intro to Software Development (Code 101): Taught basic HTML/CSS/version control concepts to students brand-new to coding in building. Facilitated deployment of their first web page using HTML, CSS, and Github.  Also taught command line basics

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Full-Stack JavaScript Development (Code 401): Answer student questions and give feedback/code review for MEAN stack topics.   

Introduction to Software Development (Code 101): Help students new to coding in with learning HTML and CSS as well as using the command line and version control (git).

positions.title: science and mathematics teacher
positions.description: Taught chemistry, physics, mathematics, and other science courses.

certifications.name: Washington State Teaching Certificate (Residency and Substitute)
certifications.title: Washington State Teaching Certificate (Residency and Substitute)

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped mentor elementary students with Hour of Code. Gave students feedback, encouragement, and problem-solving guidance while using the Minecraft and Star Wars coding challenges at code.org.  Also helped more advanced students with debugging their own Scratch code.

projects.title: BeCause Community
projects.description: Angular client for Ruby on Rails backend.  Our app will allow tech professionals to connect with others based on mutual passions/interests and allow for the sharing of ideas and building of new applications around those ideas and passions.

projects.title: Authenticat (MEAN stack authentication and authorization system)
projects.description: Token-based authentication system including drop-in router for sign-in/sign-up routes as well as authentication and role-based authorization middleware for securing custom routes. Allows people new to the concepts of authentication and authorization to drop in the library and handle authorization quickly and easily.
